distributor.name: CENTLEC (SOC) Ltd
distributor.notes: Electricity distributor for Mangaung Metropolitan Municipality (Bloemfontein) and surrounding municipalities. The centlec.co.za tariffs page still indexed only the 2025/26 schedule at time of capture; 2026/27 c/kWh schedule pending.

approved_increase.notes: 9.9% per the national 2026/27 NERSA-approval roundup. The widely-quoted 12.4% adjustment was the PREVIOUS year (2025/26) — not applicable to 2026/27.

tariff_plans.name: Residential prepaid (non-indigent)
tariff_plans.notes: NERSA-approved 2026/27 structure introduced a new R50/month basic charge (phased in from a cost-of-supply figure of R527/month; deducted from the first purchase each month) — HOWEVER Mangaung council resolved on 29 June 2026 to DEFER its implementation. Block energy rates (summer/winter) pending the 2026/27 schedule.

components.description: Basic monthly charge, NERSA-approved for 2026/27 — implementation DEFERRED by council resolution of 29 June 2026
components.notes: Deferred by special council meeting 29 June 2026, 'pending a formal resolution' — still the latest indexed status at recheck 2026-07-05. Billed as R57.50/month incl VAT (R50 + R7.50 VAT), deducted from the first electricity purchase each month; registered indigent households exempt. Phased in from a cost-of-supply figure of R527/month.
